hero.sub: Guardian of the flock. Keeper of discolorations. Never sleeps.

lore.line1: Frank is not a character. He is a consequence.
lore.line2: Since 2012, when the laboratory started producing, someone had to watch over things. Someone with the right glasses to see what others miss. With the wrong patience for everything else.
lore.line3: Black hair with white streaks. Thick beard. Pointed ears. Leather apron full of unidentified objects. A coffee mug that never empties — he calls it Caffè Turbo.
lore.line4: He talks to the skins. Studies them like living beings. He calls cheap skins 'liars.' Not selling them here was his idea.
lore.quote: If you have questions about your order — Frank answers. He's not nice. But he's precise.

cta.title: GOT QUESTIONS?
cta.body: Frank answers. At any hour. He's not nice. But he's precise. And he remembers every order that comes through the lab.
cta.note: Response guaranteed within 24 hours. Usually much sooner.

frank.headline: There's someone in the lab.
frank.body: Il Pellaio. Every sheet that comes out of here, he has already touched, smelled, judged. Guardian of living skins since 2012. He calls cheap skins 'liars.'

meta.description: The Tannery Keeper. Guardian of living skins. He feels them breathe, sweat, heal. He doesn't sleep: he watches over them.

hero.sub: The Tannery Keeper. He talks to the skins. Feels them breathe.

lore.p1: Il Pellaio is not a character. He's a consequence.
lore.p2: Since 2012, since the workshop started making its skins, someone had to stay and watch over them. Il Pellaio is that someone — the custodian every true artisan workshop carries within.
lore.p3: Twelve years of bench fumes, of catalysis, of skin breathed in too long. He no longer knows where the workshop ends and he begins. He makes them. He watches over them during the twelve hours of catalysis. He only lets them go when he's sure they're alive.
lore.p4: To Il Pellaio, skins are alive. They breathe through their pores, sweat out ink that doesn't deserve to stay, and heal — if you take care of them. Cheap skins he calls "dead", "liars": not selling them here was his battle. "A corpse doesn't heal," he says. "The wound stays open forever. My skin closes."
lore.quote: You don't tattoo it, he says. You revere it. Holy skin.

flock.label: THE FLOCK
flock.quote: Microfibers of crushed velvet — red, blue, yellow — that fall wherever they want. That's why no two skins are ever the same. Ever. Anyone who wants them all identical might as well tattoo on linoleum.

discromie.label: THE DISCHROMIAS
discromie.quote: They're not defects. They're the signature. Real skin is uneven, alive. Whoever smooths everything out has never looked closely at a forearm.

catalisi.label: THE CATALYSIS
catalisi.quote: Twelve hours. The skin is born slowly and the flocks settle where they're meant to. Anyone in a hurry doesn't deserve the skin.

pelleViva.label: LIVING SKIN
pelleViva.quote: It breathes. It sweats out ink that doesn't deserve to stay. And it heals, if you care for it. Want to know if a skin is alive? Make it heal. A real one closes. A corpse stays as it is.

drops.note: Every twelve hours, a thought from the bench. Don't expect kindness. Expect obsession.

support.note: For orders and shipping, we answer — straight to the point.

The studio opens at ten.
